title: Identifying Hate Speech Peddlers in Online Platforms. A Bayesian Social Learning Approach for Large Language Model Driven Decision-Makers
reasoning: The paper focuses on a Bayesian social learning framework to model herding behavior in agents using LLMs for decision-making. While it applies this framework to identify hate speech and mentions bias as a feature in the classification task, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or formal ethical systems.
